install_pass_detected_msg: An active Plex Pass subscription was detected. You can use webhooks for real-time synchronization.

summary_pass_instructions:
Configure the Plex Webhook in your Plex server settings,
and enter the IP and API Token in your Kodi Addon.
summary_nopass_instructions:
Enter the IP and API Token in your Kodi Addon.
SyncPK will periodically check Plex automatically.
config_pass_upgrade_hint: If you have recently subscribed to Plex Pass, please log in again to activate webhooks.
config_pass_found: Plex Pass detected! Webhooks are now enabled.
update_subtitle: SyncPK version [VERSION] is ready to download. Do you want to install it now?
update_never_notify: Do not notify about new versions
updating_subtitle: Please wait a few minutes while the system updates and restarts...
config_ui_empty: No appearance settings in the current version.
setup_lang_sub: Select the language for the installation wizard. You can change it later from Settings.
setup_plex_url_sub: Enter the local address of your Plex Media Server. Needed for webhook communication.
setup_plex_url_note: Example: http://192.168.1.100:32400. Find it in Plex → Settings → Remote Access.
setup_plex_url_err: Please enter a valid Plex URL (must start with http:// or https://).
setup_plex_auth_sub: Click the button to open Plex login in a new tab. Once you authorize, this page will continue automatically.
setup_plex_auth_desc: We use Plex's secure PIN system — no password is stored, only the access token.
setup_plex_auth_waiting: Waiting for you to authorize in Plex...
setup_plex_auth_copy: ↑ Click to copy the link if the tab did not open
setup_pass_sub: This determines how SyncPK will monitor your Plex activity.
setup_pwd_sub: This password protects access to the SyncPK dashboard. Choose something strong.
setup_tmdb_sub: Used to fetch movie and TV show posters, titles and metadata. Required for full functionality.
setup_tmdb_hint: Get your free API key at themoviedb.org. It is free and instant.
setup_tmdb_err: Please enter a valid TMDB API key.
setup_prefs_sub: Choose the language for the dashboard UI and for metadata scraping (titles, posters).
setup_sys_sub: Fine-tune update and debug behaviour. Both can be changed later from Settings.
setup_sys_autoupdate_desc: SyncPK will download and apply updates automatically when a new version is available.
setup_sys_debug_desc: Enable verbose backend logs. Only recommended for troubleshooting.
setup_summary_sub: Everything looks good. Review your configuration and click Finish to save.
setup_finish_error: An error occurred while saving. Please try again.
setup_bypass_hint: Click Continue again to proceed anyway.

Your server is now fully synchronized.

import_complete_kodi_desc: Configure this IP and your API Token in the Kodi Add-on settings.
import_complete_note: Note: You can view and modify these Webhooks at any time from the Dashboard settings.
